name: saturn-navigator
description: A navigation game in a Newtonian model of the Saturn system: fly a module through the gravity field of Saturn and its moons.
author: Richard Lipka

scripts.//scripts: The trailing `--` matters: without it npm appends extra arguments bare, so `npm run dev -- --port 5180` reaches the inner script as npm config flags and the port is silently ignored.
scripts.//core: @saturn/core is consumed through its built output, the same way a separate repository would consume it, so everything here builds it first. Core's own `prepare` covers a fresh clone; these cover an edit.
scripts.dev: npm run build:core && npm run dev --workspace @saturn/game --
scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm run build --workspace @saturn/game --
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:core && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
